sources.title: SmolLM2-360M-GGUF · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: Model Summary SmolLM2 is a family of compact language models available in three size: 135M, 360M, and 1.7B parameters. They are capable of solving a wide range of tasks while being lightweight enough to run on-device. SmolLM2 demonstrates significant advances over its predecessor SmolLM1, particularly in instruction following, knowledge, reasoning.

sources.title: SmolLM2 360M: GGUF size, RAM & VRAM requirements · localmodel.run
sources.snippet: SmolLM2 360M is small enough that the context window is the thing to size for: 128k needs ~5.7 GB versus ~1.2 GB at 4k, so pick the window you actually use. Speed drops too: every token re-reads the KV cache, so at 128k context SmolLM2 360M generates at roughly ~6% of its short-context speed. How this is estimated.
